Who we are

A Welsh family business

Family business  ·  Commercial grade quality  ·  UK and Ireland installation

A Welsh family business with woodworking in our blood, building bespoke outdoor saunas since day one. Every sauna is made to order, delivered and installed across the UK and Ireland.

Made to orderEvery sauna is made to order. Choose your length, diameter and layout.
Built to lastThermowood is heat treated timber that resists moisture, warping and decay.
Based in WalesBuilt in the same workshop as our saunas, same joinery, same attention to detail.

Real venues, real bookings

Sauna Snug at Flynn Park · Co. Dublin
A family adventure park running since 1996 added barrel saunas with a spring fed lake dip. Public sessions for up to eight, private hire for one to eight, open seven days a week.

What to put on your site
Barrel sauna
Fixed on a base or decking. Built on site by our team.
Mobile saunas
Move it, hire it out, take it to events. Our own Welsh built trailers.
Hot tubs
Pairs with the sauna for a hot and cold session. Wood fired or electric.
Ice baths
Cold to go with the hot. A single plunge or the Double Dipper for two.
Huts and pods
Extra bookable stays. Pods often need no planning.
Barrel showers
Rinse off between hot and cold. Easy to keep clean.
